questions.question: What must be decoupled so one dispatch path serves both MCP and CLI?
How should argument errors, exit codes, signals and child cleanup behave in a shared-handler CLI?
What CLI surface matches the 40 handlers without a second contract to maintain?
How does the Claude Code plugin ship and locate the CLI, and what do the official docs say about CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT in a skill and a plugin bin folder on PATH?
Can the skill go CLI-only while the mirror pairs keep parity with the Claude Project, and what does the Sync Loop declaration require?
Which files carry the route-order rewrite, and what breaks in the router benchmark and playbook gates?
What naming and placement gate wording makes a batch ask once about names and one place?
Which batch placement mechanism is worth building, and is a maxBytes target or a server guard worth the friction?
What is the ranked change list across the four implementation phases?

findings.claim: dispatchToolCall is transport-neutral in body, with one McpError import and one throw as the only MCP coupling
Argument errors are already result-shaped, so the change is to return instead of throw
index.ts self-runs at :126, so the CLI needs its own entry
loadConfig turns every bare argv token into an allowed folder candidate, so tool argv must never reach it
Child processes live in a runProcess closure, so a CLI signal handler needs an exported registry
ALL_TOOLS holds exactly 40 definitions, the one registry both transports read
Zod 4.6.5 ships z.toJSONSchema, so describe needs no new dependency
One JSON object with three intake modes is the surface that avoids a second schema layer
stdout should carry structuredContent and stderr the one-line summary
Previews must become files, since base64 image blocks have no consumer on a pipe
The capability cache is process-local while the resolver install record is file-based, so the CLI needs one cache file
MEDIA_EDITOR_DATA_DIR is the mechanism that keeps setup and health coherent, so the CLI must not override dataDir
A plugin bin folder is on the Bash PATH and blocks claude.ai and Cowork installs. The plugin path variables resolve inline in skill Markdown but are not in the Bash process environment
The plugin build already stages server and skill folders, so dist/cli.js rides the existing bundle
The dist layout must not move because three relative resolutions depend on compiled depth
Per-platform sharp and the pinned ffmpeg are already solved by the bundle build
A standalone install needs a distribution channel the private package lacks
Claude Code can disable skill shell execution, so the skill needs a stated degradation branch
All three named mirror pairs are byte-identical and the declared pair set is seven, not three
findings.evidence: cmp -s, AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop/systems.py:1252-1272

findings.claim: tools.md is already transport-neutral, so it stays mirrored and the proposal holds for it
setup.md is already keyed by surface, so the proposed split is rejected
A new skill-only reference must be declared in unmirrored_sources, mirroring the router-contract exemption
The declaration block holds 47 residency statements across ten section labels and four carry route text
choose_route should become an ordered probe list and HOST_STATES needs a CLI axis
rule_parity must not ban mcp, and SRO-001 should stay paired with PRO-001 while route scenarios split three ways
The kernel wait is ambiguity-gated at :181 and single-name at :194, which is the mechanical cause of the live bug
The batch question template goes in interactive-intelligence.md and its mirror in the same edit
The two field descriptions present an omitted fileName and subfolder as normal, and one edit reaches all 40 tools through listedInputSchema
Multi-input image_convert beats a targetFolder field, because layout many already defaults to one numbered folder
maxBytes on image_convert is not worth adding, since quality is a fidelity dial and outputs bytes already reports the size
A server guard against unconfirmed names is rejected because no request boundary exists, and outputName being required already prevents unnamed folders
The playbook has 31 files and no batch scenario on either surface
The ranked change list names every touched file across the four phases
